tension_flow.population: unique retained dream sessions and current unresolved risks

tension_halflife.population: retained closure events with known aware UTC times
tension_halflife.interpretation: closure lifetime distribution, not verified-fix half-life

reappearance_rate.population: retained closure events with stable risk identity
reappearance_rate.interpretation: recorded reopenings; concern identity is not an entity pair

domain_saturation.interpretation: domain population; unknown domains are explicit

hub_health.population: typed factual entities and canonical fact relationships
hub_health.interpretation: description coverage among connected entities, not correctness

confidence_integrity.interpretation: confidence availability and assertion classes, not truth accuracy

promotion_funnel.population: latest typed canonical candidates and retained promotion rows
promotion_funnel.interpretation: current independently supported candidates versus historical promotion labels

orphan_pressure.population: all seven typed factual families and canonical fact relationships
orphan_pressure.interpretation: known isolated entities and unresolved relationship endpoints

model_impact.population: retained dream artifacts with explicit model provenance
model_impact.interpretation: attribution only; no guessed model identity or usefulness

maturity_score.population: canonical result state and latest typed candidates
maturity_score.interpretation: evidence coverage; no composite score can erase critical defects

meaningful_edges.interpretation: accepted decision rate; task meaningfulness remains unmeasured

domain_entropy.population: known-domain factual entities; unknowns excluded and counted
domain_entropy.interpretation: population distribution, not health or desired attention

cognitive_load.population: current unresolved risks, unproven candidates and dirty scopes
cognitive_load.interpretation: workload, not agent confusion or understanding
